How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Sri Ganganagar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 26-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS Sri Ganganagar recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the ECHS Sri Ganganagar recruitment is 26th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this ECHS Sri Ganganagar recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Officer-in-Charge, Medical Officer, and Dental Hygienist/Assistant in the ECHS Sri Ganganagar recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this ECHS Sri Ganganagar recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via speed post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Officer-in-Charge and Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The salary for both the Officer-in-Charge and Medical Officer posts is Rs. 95,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Dental Hygienist/Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Dental Hygienist/Assistant post, candidates must hold a Diploma in Dental and possess 05 years of experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any specific requirement for the Officer-in-Charge post?
faq.answer: Yes, the Officer-in-Charge post is exclusively for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and requires a Graduate degree with 05 years of experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these ECHS Sri Ganganagar posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts includes an Interview followed by On Job Training (OJT).

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS, which is www.echs.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are on a contractual basis, typically for a period of 11 months.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for the Dental Hygienist/Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Dental Hygienist/Assistant post is Rs. 36,500/- per month.
